project: SEO operations dashboard for a non-technical website owner
context: Hybrid fullstack React JavaScript + Tailwind + shadcn/ui + FastAPI
theme: Light-first operational workspace with an optional dark mode toggle; warm paper base and ink-blue functional accents.

design_concepts.name: Searchlight Desk
design_concepts.direction: Editorial newspaper hierarchy fused with an air-traffic control dashboard and archival index cards. Best balance of trust, clarity, and personality.

design_concepts.name: Crawl Room
design_concepts.direction: Swiss information design fused with transit maps and utility control panels. Dense but calm technical diagnosis.

design_concepts.name: Site Clinic
design_concepts.direction: Warm clinic wayfinding fused with botanical field notes and structured SEO checks. Friendly for a non-technical owner.

design_concepts.name: Signal Ledger
design_concepts.direction: Financial ledger rhythm fused with newsroom alerts and monochrome data visualization. Strong for prioritization and audit history.

design_concepts.name: Workshop Console
design_concepts.direction: Maker-workbench labels fused with browser devtools and simple step-by-step repair flows. Most playful, but still practical.

research_notes.descriptor: Put site health, indexation, crawl errors, and backlinks in a visible operational hierarchy rather than hiding them in charts.

research_notes.reference: Google Search Console query dashboard pattern
research_notes.descriptor: Use compact KPI strips for clicks, impressions, CTR, and position, followed by query and landing-page tables.
Combine multi-source metrics in a single overview, but label the source and freshness of every integration.
Explain canonical, robots.txt, and noindex as different controls; never imply robots.txt prevents indexing or sets a canonical.
Show connection state as verified, needs action, or not connected; never claim a third-party integration without a backend verification response.

typography.heading: IBM Plex Sans, 700/500, tracking-tight; distinctive but highly readable for an operations tool.
typography.mono: IBM Plex Mono for URLs, status codes, timestamps, and technical snippets.
rules: Do not use Inter, Roboto, or generic system fonts for headings

colors.archetype: Swiss and high-contrast with a warm paper twist
rules: Use primary sparingly for actions and selected navigation
Use status colors only for status meaning
No teal dashboard palette, no forbidden #7351B7, no full-screen gradients
All normal text must meet 4.5:1 contrast; large text and controls at least 3:1
Use tinted neutrals rather than pure black or gray

visual_enhancers: Subtle paper grain via CSS pseudo-element with low opacity and aria-hidden=true
Thin ruled dividers and offset index-card borders; avoid excessive rounded cards
One small animated signal line in the active audit header, not decorative motion everywhere
Custom scrollbar with warm tinted thumb and no gutter
Use layered shadows only on elevated drawers and menus; dashboard widgets are flat with 1px borders

navigation.desktop: Solid or opaque glass header with brand mark 'Searchlight', links Audit, Indexing, Tools, AutoBlog, and primary Run audit button.
navigation.mobile: Visible brand plus menu button; mobile menu must expose all links and the CTA.
requirements: Header has z-50 and non-transparent background
Active route has both color and underline/border cue

layouts.app_shell: Desktop: left rail 248px plus main content; mobile: stacked content with collapsible nav.
layouts.overview: 12-column desktop grid with a large priority panel spanning 8 columns, a tall integration health panel spanning 4, then metric tiles and issue queue. Mobile becomes one column.
layouts.audit: High-density grid: summary metrics, issue table, backlink/page-link review, and GEO keyword table. Keep tables left aligned and use row-level repair actions.
layouts.indexing: Two-column desktop layout: URL check form and explanation on left; results timeline and status breakdown on right. Include canonical, robots, noindex, sitemap, response code, and rendered HTML checks.
layouts.tools: Tetris-like workspace: background remover as dominant panel, image quality inspector as tall side panel, small utility actions below.
layouts.autoblog: Step flow: topic and simple-English brief, affiliate product fields, image upload validation, duplicate-content warning, preview, save/draft/publish. Never auto-publish without explicit confirmation.
layouts.empty_space: Leave breathing room around primary issue and do not fill every grid cell with cards.

seo_audit: broken internal links and backlinks with source URL, target URL, anchor, and status
GEO keyword clusters with location, intent, impressions, clicks, and opportunity
prioritized repair queue with severity and one next action
indexing: server-verified HTTP status, canonical, robots meta, X-Robots-Tag, sitemap presence, mobile/render check
show Google/Bing submission status only when API response confirms it
explain rejected vs failed in simple English
tool_reliability: background remover shows processing, success, retry, and provider error states
image validation checks file type, dimensions, aspect ratio, file size, compression, and quality
autoblogger duplicate scan and affiliate disclosure field are mandatory before publish

interaction_and_motion.entrance: Stagger issue rows and metric groups by 40ms; use opacity and translateY only.
interaction_and_motion.hover: Buttons darken and lift 1px; rows reveal a repair action; explicit hover text colors required.
interaction_and_motion.press: Scale 0.98 on buttons with 120ms transform transition.
interaction_and_motion.loading: Use skeleton blocks and a determinate audit progress bar with text, never motion alone.
interaction_and_motion.toast: Use Sonner at /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx for connection, save, and retry feedback.
interaction_and_motion.reduced_motion: Disable stagger, signal animation, and transforms under prefers-reduced-motion.
avoid: auto-playing or indefinite spinners without status text

requirements: Every button, link, input, menu, status, balance, result, and confirmation includes a stable kebab-case data-testid
Use semantic landmarks, table captions, labels, and aria-live for audit completion
Keyboard accessible tabs, drawers, dropdowns, and dialogs via shadcn primitives
Do not communicate status by color alone; pair color with text and icon
Focus ring must be higher contrast than default
Use descriptive error messages with a fix suggestion

media.guidance: This is an operational dashboard; do not add stock photography or placeholder image URLs. Use CSS texture and inline accessible SVG diagrams only.
upload_rules: show max file size and recommended dimensions before upload
preserve aspect ratio and provide a crop/fit choice
show original and optimized byte size
never silently replace a user image

3d_libraries.reason: Clarity and trust matter more than immersion for SEO diagnostics; prefer CSS/SVG and Recharts for charts.

rules: Use accessible labels and table alternative
Use color-blind-friendly primary, warning, error, and neutral series
Prefer sparklines and simple lines/bars; avoid 3D charts and gauges without numeric values

implementation_notes_for_js: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for shell layout and shadcn primitives for inputs, dialogs, selects, tabs, tables, and toasts
Do not use native select/datepicker for advanced interactions
Keep grid items as direct children of grid containers
Add data-testid to every interactive and key informational element
Use real API response states; CONNECTION STATES MUST NOT BE MOCKED in production
If a provider is unavailable, label the state 'Not verified' and give a manual setup path instead of claiming success

required_backend_checks: Bing Webmaster site and sitemap response
Google Search Console property and inspection response
background-removal provider health and job result
api_truthfulness.mocked: Any demo fixtures used during development must be visibly labeled MOCKED and removed or gated before production.

general_ui_ux_design_guidelines: Design for a non-technical owner: plain English, one clear next action, progressive disclosure
Never use a generic centered landing layout; use an asymmetric operational grid
Use generous p-6/p-8 spacing and internal padding in every bordered container
Use opaque header and menu surfaces; never place readable content on a fully transparent surface
Use micro-interactions for hover, focus, press, loading, and success
Maintain visible desktop navigation with 3-5 links and a primary CTA
Make mobile responsive from one column upward
No emoji icons; use lucide or existing shadcn-compatible icons
Do not promise SEO traffic or indexing outcomes; show evidence, timestamps, and limitations
Customize scrollbar and honor reduced motion
acceptance_checklist: A user can see the top three SEO problems within five seconds
Each problem explains why it matters and has a repair action
Canonical, robots, and noindex are clearly distinguished
Indexing and integration statuses identify verified vs unverified
Background remover and AutoBlog expose loading/error/retry states
Autoblog supports affiliate product name, URL, price, disclosure, and CTA fields
Image uploads show dimensions, size, quality, and optimization result
All tests can target stable data-testid attributes
No placeholder image URLs or unsupported integration claims
